description: This file contains utility functions for managing network ports in a testing environment, including checking port availability, acquiring free ports, and allocating deterministic port blocks for parallel tests.

methods.name: isPortFree
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is free by attempting to create and listen on it.

methods.name: getOsFreePort
methods.description: Requests the OS to assign a free port by creating a server with port 0.

methods.name: getDeterministicFreePortBlock
methods.description: Allocates a deterministic block of ports for a worker or process, avoiding collisions in parallel tests.

methods.name: getFreePortBlockWithPermissionFallback
methods.description: Attempts to get a port block deterministically, falls back to a permission-based port if necessary.
